issues: document.documentElement.scrollWidth ~1174-1198 vs clientWidth 320-820 -> HORIZONTAL OVERFLOW. Masked visually by body overflow-x:hidden in index.css but genuine layout break. All main left-column children (H1, meta, uf-card price block, feature grid, buttons) report width=1174. RCA: top-level `div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.05fr_236px]"` in HamperDetail.jsx has NO explicit mobile grid-cols, so the implicit single grid track sizes to the intrinsic width of its widest child. The Gift Shelf aside's inner horizontal strip renders ~6 hamper tiles of w-[180px] shrink-0 (6*180 + gaps ~= 1140px). Because the strip's wrapper is overflow-x-auto, it still contributes min-content=1140px to the grid track, forcing the whole column (and siblings) to 1174px.

Same class of bug, worse magnitude: document.scrollWidth=1574-1582 vs clientWidth=320-820. Caused by the Harvest Shelf aside's horizontal strip of ~8 fruit tiles whose intrinsic width stretches the implicit grid track. Children (H1, meta, price card) measure 1558px wide.

action_items: FIX /app/frontend/src/pages/HamperDetail.jsx line 72: change `grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.05fr_236px]` to `grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.05fr_236px]` AND add `min-w-0` to each of the three grid children (LEFT div, CENTER div, aside) so flex/grid items cannot blow past their track. Equivalently/additionally wrap the aside's horizontal strip in a container with `w-full overflow-hidden` (not just overflow-x-auto) OR change the inner strip from `flex` to a width-constrained container (e.g. `w-full` with `max-w-full` + ensure children have shrink-0 but parent has min-w-0).
FIX /app/frontend/src/pages/FruitDetail.jsx: same pattern — add `grid-cols-1` default and `min-w-0` to grid children, or constrain the Harvest Shelf horizontal strip's intrinsic width.
Consider REMOVING body `overflow-x: hidden` from /app/frontend/src/index.css after the real fix — currently it masks future overflow regressions.
Optional: investigate ref counter in enquiries for strict uniqueness (duplicate UF1003 observed in DB).
critical_code_review_comments: HamperDetail.jsx and FruitDetail.jsx: both rely on default implicit single grid track at mobile which inherits intrinsic width from the widest child; always set `grid-cols-1` default and `min-w-0` on items when any child can be wider than the viewport.
index.css body { overflow-x: hidden } hides overflow — anti-pattern that will mask real regressions; prefer fixing the overflow source.

HamperDetail.jsx line 262 — the aside's inner strip toggles between `flex overflow-x-auto` (mobile) and `lg:grid lg:overflow-visible` (desktop) which is good intent, but needs `min-w-0` on parent for `flex-basis:0` style constraint to work in grid context.

rca of the issue: RCA — Horizontal overflow on /hampers/{slug} and /fruits/{slug} below 1024px: Both detail pages use a top-level `div class="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_1.05fr_236px]"`. At viewports <lg, grid-template-columns is implicit, so the single auto track is sized by `max-content` of its items. The right-side aside contains a horizontal strip (`flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto`) of fixed-width tiles (`w-[180px] shrink-0`). Even though the strip is overflow-x-auto, its CSS `min-width` defaults to `auto` which in a flex container resolves to the sum of children (~1140px for 6 hampers on hamper page, ~1558px for 8 fruits on fruit page). This min-width propagates up through the grid item to the grid track, stretching all siblings (title, price card, feature cards) to that width. Body `overflow-x: hidden` (newly added in index.css) hides the horizontal scrollbar but does NOT fix the underlying layout — mobile users still see content clipped/misaligned when the layout engine positions wide children at left:16, right:1190. Reproduction: open /hampers/royal-exotic-basket at 375px, run `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` -> 1190 while clientWidth=375. Mitigation (minimal diff): add `grid-cols-1` to the mobile grid definition and `min-w-0` to each grid child; this forces the single track to 100% of the parent and lets children clip/wrap properly. Same fix for FruitDetail.jsx. After the fix the Gift Shelf / Harvest Shelf naturally become horizontally scrollable within their own 100%-wide container as intended.
